Elite Advanced Laser.why: Elite Advanced Laser packages and tests optical-communication laser diodes and builds high-speed / silicon-photonics optical modules (21% of 2025 revenue) for data centers and AI computing; optical-module demand drives its revenue.
Elite Advanced Laser.evidence: Elite Advanced Laser Annual Report 2025: High Speed Transmission Optical Module (including Silicon Photonics Products) NT$1,810,955 thousand, 21% of 2025 revenue, applied in data centers, AI computing, 5G, HPC and automotive LiDAR.

players.product: Laser-diode and optical-communication packaging and testing (OEM), high-speed transmission optical modules including silicon photonics products, 400G/800G AOC and 800G LPO, and external-light-source submodules; also power-semiconductor packaging and testing

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 consolidated sales NT$8,584,594 thousand (2024 net sales NT$7,567,661 thousand); EPS NT$5.01. Revenue by product: Optical Information and Optical Communication Products NT$1,447,729 thousand (17%), Power Semiconductor Packaging and Testing NT$5,325,910 thousand (62%), High Speed Transmission Optical Module (including Silicon Photonics Products) NT$1,810,955 thousand (21%).
quarterly_data.figure: NT$8,584,594 thousand; optical comm 17%, power semi 62%, high-speed optical module 21%

quarterly_data.signal: Successfully developed in 2025: new high-speed gain-type EML components, 400G/800G active optical cable sensors, silicon photonics active bonding process, array high-power external light source submodules, and silicon photonics high-speed transmission optical modules. Under development: 800G linear-drive pluggable optics (LPO), high-power non-temperature-controlled pluggable external light source modules, 50G PON components, heterogeneous integrated packaging.

The company says it is one of the top three laser-diode packaging and testing foundries in the world and that its customers are mostly leading optical communication and optical information companies (company claim). It names Broadcom, Lumentum, Mitsubishi, Sumitomo, Rohm, Coherent, Fabrinet and Zhongji Innolight as major overseas laser industry suppliers (market overview, not customers).

Customer concentration: Client AAAA NT$1,668,470 thousand, 19% of 2025 net sales (26% in 2024); Client AAO NT$793,660 thousand, 9% (10% in 2024). Customers are not named. For the high-speed optical module line, laser die, DSP and PIC come from unnamed suppliers (Company A / B / C).

2026 operating plan: management will adjust product development and marketing to data-center and AI market changes, keep developing new products and expand production scale. 2026 estimated sales quantity (thousands): Optical Information and Optical Communication Products 77,099; Power Semiconductor Products 6,464,648; Silicon Photonics Products 297.
quarterly_data.figure: Silicon Photonics Products 297 thousand units (2026 estimate)
